title: log.gap
description: This reader missed a stretch: it reconnected too late for the store, or fell behind and the fanout dropped ephemeral entries. When the platform has a snapshot, it is here so the reader can catch up in one step. Never stored; sent to the reader.

LogGap.description: This reader missed a stretch: it reconnected too late for the store, or fell behind and the fanout dropped ephemeral entries. When the platform has a snapshot, it is here so the reader can catch up in one step. Never stored; sent to the reader.

from_seq.description: The first seq the reader did not get.

to_seq.description: The last seq the reader did not get.

snapshot.description: The state at to_seq, when the platform could compute it. Null when only ephemeral entries were dropped.
